adwaita-mono.author: GNOME
adwaita-mono.description: A tweaked version of Iosevka, made to look similar to Adwaita's proportional font (based on Inter).
adwaita-mono.name: Adwaita Mono

anka-coder.author: Andrey Makarov
anka-coder.description: The Anka/Coder family is a monospaced, courier-width (60% of height; em size 2048x1229) font that can be used for source code, terminal windows etc.
anka-coder.name: Anka/Coder
anka-coder.variants: regular, bold, italic, bold-italic; in regular, condensed and narrow widths.

annotation-mono.author: Qwerasd
annotation-mono.description: Annotation Mono is an idealized handwriting; using letter forms inspired by monospace bitmap fonts, legibility is maximized while retaining a hand-written character.
annotation-mono.name: Annotation Mono
annotation-mono.variants: A variable font in 10 weights, each with italics (oblique).

anonymous-pro.author: Mark Simonson
anonymous-pro.description: Anonymous Pro is an evolution of the original Anonymous, adding lots of character sets and styles.
anonymous-pro.name: Anonymous Pro

apl2741.author: Adrian Smith
apl2741.description: This was hand digitised as a PostScript Type-3 font from an original 2741 golf-ball salvaged from an IBM selectric typewriter.
apl2741.name: APL2741

apl385.author: Adrian Smith
apl385.description: Developed with all APL software vendors in the late 1980s and enhanced as required with new characters with support from Dave Liebtag (IBM), Richard Nabavi (APL.68000) and Dyalog APL.
apl385.name: APL385

aporetic-sans.author: Protesilaos Stavrou
aporetic-sans.description: A customised build of the Iosevka that optimises for inter-glyph and inter-style consistency within the overarching constraint of usability at small point sizes.
aporetic-sans.name: Aporetic Sans Mono

aporetic-serif.author: Protesilaos Stavrou
aporetic-serif.description: A customised build of the Iosevka that optimises for inter-glyph and inter-style consistency within the overarching constraint of usability at small point sizes.
aporetic-serif.name: Aporetic Serif Mono

atkinson-hyperlegible.author: Braille Institute
atkinson-hyperlegible.description: At Braille Institute, we’ve created a family of hyperlegible™ fonts designed to improve legibility and readability for individuals with low vision.
atkinson-hyperlegible.name: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono
atkinson-hyperlegible.variants: A variable font in 7 weights, each with italics.

audio-link.author: llealloo
audio-link.description: AudioLink is a system that analyzes and processes in-world audio into many different highly reactive data streams and exposes the data to VRChat Udon, world shaders, and avatar shaders.
audio-link.name: AudioLink Mono

aurulent.author: Stephen G. Hartke
aurulent.description: Aurulent Sans is a humanist sans serif intended to be used as an interface font.
aurulent.name: Aurulent Sans Mono

average.author: Richard Alexander Hall
average.description: AverageMono is an average of thirteen different fonts which are all derivatives of the public domain Courier typeface.
average.name: Average Mono

azeret.author: Martin Vácha
azeret.description: The story of the typeface began with a draft that was driven by an exploration of OCR fonts, past and futuristic operating systems, various interfaces and the nineties.
azeret.name: Azeret Mono
azeret.variants: A variable font in 8 weights, each with italics.

b612-mono.author: Nicolas Chauveau, Thomas Paillot, Jonathan Favre-Lamarine, Jean-Luc Vinot
b612-mono.description: B612 is an highly legible open source font family designed and tested to be used on aircraft cockpit screens.
b612-mono.name: B612 Mono

bedstead.author: Ben Harris
bedstead.description: Bedstead is a family of outline fonts based on the characters produced by the Mullard SAA5050 series of Teletext Character Generators.
bedstead.name: Bedstead
bedstead.variants: 6 widths in both regular and bold.

bigblue-terminal.author: VileR
bigblue-terminal.description: It follows the metrics and dimensions of Windows' old Terminal font (at the 9pt/12px size), but the appearance is closer to the classic IBM PC text mode character sets.
bigblue-terminal.name: BigBlue Terminal

binchotan-sharp.author: Rabbit Viceroy Klein
binchotan-sharp.description: A fixed-width typeface. Horizontal metrics compatible with CJK console fonts. Small size legibile.
binchotan-sharp.name: Binchotan Sharp

bitstream-vera.author: Jim Lyles
bitstream-vera.description: Vera is a digital typeface (computer font) superfamily with a liberal license. It was designed by Jim Lyles from the now-defunct Bitstream Inc. type foundry.
bitstream-vera.name: Bitstream Vera Sans Mono

borg-sans-mono.author: Marnen E. Laibow-Koser
borg-sans-mono.description: Droid Sans Mono Slashed + Hasklig-style ligatures!
borg-sans-mono.name: Borg Sans Mono

bpmono.author: George Triantafyllakos
bpmono.description: A monospaced typeface suitable for technical texts and/or programming
bpmono.name: BPmono

bront-dejavu.author: Chris Wendt
bront-dejavu.description: Bront is a collection of tweaked fonts geared towards programming.
bront-dejavu.name: Bront DejaVu Sans Mono

bront-ubuntu.author: Chris Wendt
bront-ubuntu.description: Bront is a collection of tweaked fonts geared towards programming.
bront-ubuntu.name: Bront Ubuntu Mono

camingocode.author: Jan Fromm
camingocode.description: Based on CamingoMono, but has several specially drawn glyphs that work well at small sizes.
camingocode.name: CamingoCode

cartograph.author: Connary Fagen
cartograph.description: A monospaced typeface with character and warmth, Cartograph is a handsome font family featuring a lush, cursive italic, code-friendly ligatures, and a proportional set accessible via OpenType.
cartograph.name: Cartograph
cartograph.variants: 8 weights and various alternatives via OpenType sets, including ligatures.

cascadia-code.author: Aaron Bell
cascadia-code.description: This is a fun, new monospaced font that includes programming ligatures and is designed to enhance the modern look and feel of the Windows Terminal.
cascadia-code.name: Cascadia Code
cascadia-code.variants: 6 weights and various alternatives via OpenType sets, including slashed zeroes and cursive italics.

chivo.author: Héctor Gatti & Omnibus-Type Team
chivo.description: Chivo (‘goat’ in Spanish) is the first Omnibus-Type neo-grotesque typeface family.
chivo.name: Chivo Mono
chivo.variants: A variable font in 9 weights, each with italics.

cilantro-code-mono.author: DraftingDreamer
cilantro-code-mono.description: A Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) monospace coding font with exact 2:1 duospace metrics: 2 Latin characters occupy 1 Han character cell. Han glyphs from Iansui, Latin from Red Hat Mono.
cilantro-code-mono.name: Cilantro Code Mono

cm-unicode.author: Donald E. Knuth
cm-unicode.description: Computer Modern is the original family of typefaces used by the typesetting program TeX.
cm-unicode.name: Computer Modern Unicode Typewriter

code-new-roman.author: Samiru R.
code-new-roman.description: Code New Roman is aimed for use in programming environments and other circumstances where a monospaced font is specified.
code-new-roman.name: Code New Roman

comic-mono.author: Thai Pangsakulyanont
comic-mono.description: A legible monospace font… the very typeface you’ve been trained to recognize since childhood. This font is a fork of Shannon Miwa’s Comic Shanns.
comic-mono.name: Comic Mono

comic-shanns.author: Shannon Miwa
comic-shanns.description: Do you lie awake every night dreaming about a world where you could write your code in Comic Sans where it looks just as beautiful as on your dear presentations?
comic-shanns.name: Comic Shanns

commit-mono.author: Eigil Nikolajsen
commit-mono.description: Commit Mono is an anonymous and neutral coding font focused on creating a better reading experience.
commit-mono.name: Commit Mono
commit-mono.variants: A download can be customized with various of weights, ligatures, dotted or slashed zeroes, and other styles.

consolamono.author: Wojciech Kalinowski
consolamono.description: “It's my old unfinished font. I made some sketches of several glyphs 5-6 years ago, and I never finished this. Now I made missing glyphs, did changes of some glyphs and turn into monospaced font.”
consolamono.name: Consola Mono

courier-ibm.author: Howard Kettler
courier-ibm.description: IBM’s original Courier digitized and made available in modern file formats.Here credited to the original designer, but maintained by Darren Embry.
courier-ibm.name: IBM Courier

courier-ibm-dotted.author: Darren Embry
courier-ibm-dotted.description: IBM’s original Courier digitized and made available in modern file formats. This is the dotted zero variant, improved for programming by Darren Embry.
courier-ibm-dotted.name: IBM Courier (dot)

courier-ibm-slashed.author: Darren Embry
courier-ibm-slashed.description: IBM’s original Courier digitized and made available in modern file formats. This is the slashed zero variant, improved for programming by Darren Embry.
courier-ibm-slashed.name: IBM Courier (slash)

courier-prime.author: Alan Dague-Greene
courier-prime.description: We set out to make the best damn Courier ever.
courier-prime.name: Courier Prime

courier-prime-code.author: Alan Dague-Greene
courier-prime-code.description: The goodness of Courier Prime without the serifs. Code-optimized for programmers
courier-prime-code.name: Courier Prime Code

courier-prime-sans.author: Alan Dague-Greene
courier-prime-sans.description: The goodness of Courier Prime without the serifs.
courier-prime-sans.name: Courier Prime Sans

cousine.author: Steve Matteson
cousine.description: An innovative, refreshing sans serif design that is metrically compatible with Courier New.
cousine.name: Cousine

cozette.author: Slavfox
cozette.description: Cozette is a 6x13px bitmap font based on Dina, which itself is based on Proggy. It's also heavily inspired by Creep.
cozette.name: Cozette

cutive.author: Vernon Adams
cutive.description: The design of Cutive Mono is based on a number of classic typewriter typefaces, in particular the faces of IBM's Executive, and the older Smith-Premier.
cutive.name: Cutive Mono

d2coding.author: Yong-Rak Park; Jeong-Hwan Yoon; Sang-Min Lee;
d2coding.description: 나눔바른고딕을 바탕으로 개발자의 코딩을 위해 가독성 및 유사 문자간 변별력 뿐만 아니라 디자인적으로 한글과의 조화를 고려해 최적화시킨 글꼴입니다.
d2coding.name: D2Coding

daddytimemono.author: Jason Stewart
daddytimemono.description: A monospaced font for programmers and other terminal groupies.
daddytimemono.name: DaddyTimeMono

dejavu.author: Deja Vu Project
dejavu.description: The DejaVu fonts are a font family based on the Vera Fonts. Its purpose is to provide a wider range of characters while maintaining the original look and feel.
dejavu.name: DejaVu Mono

dejavu-markup.author: Brian Dunn
dejavu-markup.description: Adopted from DejaVu to be more suited to text-document markup languages: shortened the en-dash and lowered the minus.
dejavu-markup.name: DejaVu Markup

departure-mono.author: Helena Zhang

dm-mono.author: Colophon Foundry

dpsdbeyond.author: University of the Aegean
dpsdbeyond.description: DPSDbeyond is the result of an attempt by the students of the University of the Aegean, to design a typeface in a collaborative way, during a one-day workshop.
dpsdbeyond.name: DPSDbeyond

drafting.author: Owen Earl
drafting.description: An ode to our past.  A celebration of inconsistencies.

droid-sans.author: Steve Matteson
droid-sans.description: A font family first released in 2007 and created by Ascender Corporation for use by the Open Handset Alliance platform Android.
droid-sans.name: Droid Sans

edlo.author: Eric Hamiter
edlo.description: A modified version of Stephen G. Hartke’s Aurulent Sans, which while beautiful, is also hazardous for programming due to the similarities between zeroes and ohs and ones and els.

effects-eighty.author: Peter Hull
effects-eighty.description: An homage to the dot-matrix printers of the 1980s.
effects-eighty.name: Effects Eighty

eirian.author: GGBotNet
eirian.description: GGBotNet develops, designs and distributes free fonts.
eirian.name: Eirian

ellograph.author: Connary Fagen
ellograph.description: A friendly monospaced typeface with a soft, rounded construction and striking cursive italics. A generous x-height and short descenders allow for even, flowing lines of text.

ellograph.variants: 8 weights, italics, and additional OpenType variations.

envy-code-b.author: Damien Guard
envy-code-b.description: It’s been a long time coming but finally – a TrueType conversion of my programming font Envy Code B.
envy-code-b.name: Envy Code B

envy-code-r.author: Damien Guard
envy-code-r.description: [The] new box-drawing, shading and symbols make Envy Code R a great font for the command-prompt.
envy-code-r.name: Envy Code R

fairfax.author: Rebecca G. Bettencourt
fairfax.description: Fairfax is a 6x12 bitmap font for terminals, text editors, IDEs, etc.

fairfax-hd.name: Fairfax HD

fairfax-hd-hax.author: Rebecca G. Bettencourt

fairfax-hd-hax.name: Fairfax Hax HD

fairfax-serif.author: Rebecca G. Bettencourt
fairfax-serif.description: Fairfax is a 6x12 bitmap font for terminals, text editors, IDEs, etc. It supports many scripts and a large number of Unicode blocks as well as constructed scripts as encoded in the Under-ConScript Unicode Registry, pseudographics and semigraphics, and tons of private use characters.
fairfax-serif.name: Fairfax Serif

fantasque-sans.author: Jany Belluz

fantasque-sans.name: Fantasque Sans Mono

fifteen.author: James Kilfiger
fifteen.description: It is designed to be narrow, and allow 132 columns to be comfortably fitted on a screen.

fira.author: Erik Spiekerman
fira.description: Mozilla's new typeface, used in Firefox OS

firacode.author: Nikita Prokopov
firacode.description: Free monospaced font with programming ligatures.

fixedsys.author: Travis Owens
fixedsys.description: The oldest font in Microsoft Windows, and was the system font in Windows 1.0 and 2.0, where it was simply named System.

fixedsys-ligatures.author: Darien Valentine

font3270.author: Ricardo Bánffy

fragment-mono.author: Wei H

generic.author: Luc Devroye

geist.author: Vercel
geist.description: Geist is designed for legibility and simplicity. It is a modern, geometric typeface that is based on the principles of classic Swiss typography.
geist.name: Geist Mono

gintronic.author: Mark Frömberg
gintronic.description: Gintronic’s gentle appearance makes it a delight to work constantly with code.

gnu-freefont.author: Primož Peterlin, Steve White

go-mono.author: Kris Holmes and Charles Bigelow

gohufont-11.author: Hugo Chargois
gohufont-11.description: Gohufont is a monospace bitmap font well suited for programming and terminal use. It is intended to be very legible with discernable glyphs for all characters, signs and symbols. In 11 or 14 pixels.

gohufont-14.author: Hugo Chargois
gohufont-14.description: Gohufont is a monospace bitmap font well suited for programming and terminal use. It is intended to be very legible with discernable glyphs for all characters, signs and symbols. In 11 or 14 pixels.
gohufont-14.name: Gohufont 14

google-sans-code.author: Chris Simpkins
google-sans-code.description: Google Sans Code is a fixed-width font family, designed to bring clarity, readability, and a bit of Google's distinctive brand character to code.

hack.author: Chris Simpkins
hack.description: Hack is designed to be a workhorse typeface for source code.

hack-ligatured.author: Gary Lo
hack-ligatured.description: The latest Hack Font version automatically patched with latest FiraCode ligatures (a version using JetBrains Mono is also available).

hasklig.author: Paul D. Hunt, Teo Tuominen
hasklig.description: A code font with monospaced ligatures, designed for Haskell.

hermit.author: Pablo Caro

heterodox-mono.author: Hao Chi Kiang, Alexey Kryukov

ia-writer-mono.author: Mike Abbink, Paul van der Laan, Pieter van Rosmalen, Oliver Reichenstein

ibm-vga.author: IBM
ibm-vga.description: The 9x16 glyphs make up the famous font which remains most strongly associated with ASCII art on the PC, and probably with the entire DOS era in general.

inconsolata.author: Raph Levien
inconsolata.description: Inconsolata is a monospace font, designed for code listings and the like, in print. First and foremost, it is a humanist sans design.
inconsolata.name: Inconsolata

inconsolata-g.author: Leonardo Maffi
inconsolata-g.description: A customized version of Inconsolata, with straight quotes, a dotted zero, and various other tweaks.

inconsolata-go.author: Raph Levien
inconsolata-go.description: Inconsolata is a monospace font, designed for code listings and the like, in print. InconsolataGo is Inconsolata with straight quotes.
inconsolata-go.name: InconsolataGo

inconsolata-otf.author: Raph Levien

inconsolata-otf.name: Inconsolata OTF

input.author: David Jonathan Ross
input.description: Input is a flexible system of fonts designed specifically for code, and is free for personal use.

input-compressed.author: David Jonathan Ross
input-compressed.description: Input is a flexible system of fonts designed specifically for code, and is free for personal use. This is the compressed version.
input-compressed.name: Input Mono Compressed
input-compressed.variants: A download can be customized with dozens of weights, widths, dotted or slashed zeroes, and other styles.

input-condensed.author: David Jonathan Ross
input-condensed.description: Input is a flexible system of fonts designed specifically for code, and is free for personal use. This is the condensed version.
input-condensed.name: Input Mono Condensed
input-condensed.variants: A download can be customized with dozens of weights, widths, dotted or slashed zeroes, and other styles.

input-narrow.author: David Jonathan Ross

intel-one-mono.author: Intel Brand Team, VMLY&R, Frere-Jones Type

iosevka.author: Renzhi Li
iosevka.description: An open-source, sans-serif + slab-serif, monospace + quasi‑proportional typeface family, designed for writing code, using in terminals, and preparing technical documents.

iosevka-slab.author: Renzhi Li

iosevka-slab-extended.author: Renzhi Li

iosevka-slab-extended.variants: Iosevka Slab Extended shares Iosevka's 7 weights, 3 slopes, and OpenType customizability with slab-serif styling and extended width.

ioskeley.author: Ahmed Hatem

julia-mono.author: cormullion

latin-modern.author: Donald E. Knuth

league.name: League Mono

lekton.author: Accademia di Belle Arti di Urbino
lekton.description: Lekton has been designed at ISIA Urbino, Italy, and is inspired by some of the typefaces used on the Olivetti typewriters.
lekton.name: Lekton

liberation.author: Steve Matteson
liberation.description: The Liberation fonts are metrically compatible with the most popular fonts on the Microsoft Windows operating system and the Microsoft Office software package.
liberation.name: Liberation Mono

lilex.author: Mikhael Khrustik
lilex.description: Lilex is the modern programming font containing a set of ligatures for common programming multi-character combinations.
lilex.name: Lilex

lotion.author: Nina Belikova
lotion.description: A free monospace font for programming! There are variants with and without ligatures.
lotion.name: Lotion

luculent.author: Andrew Kensler

luculent.name: Luculent

luxi.author: Kris Holmes and Charles Bigelow

luxi.name: Luxi Mono

lyth-mono.author: Yuri Turov
lyth-mono.description: A custom metrics Iosevka build aiming for a square-ish 'technical' look with good legibility at small sizes.

maple.author: subframe7536
maple.description: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font for IDE and command line.

martian-mono.author: Roman Shamin

martian-mono.name: Martian Mono

md-io.author: Rutherford Craze

md-io.name: MD IO

mensch.author: Robey Pointer
mensch.description: Designed in reaction to the release of Menlo, and intended as a tweaked variation on it.
mensch.name: Mensch

meslo.author: André Berg
meslo.description: Meslo LG is a customized version of Apple’s Menlo-Regular font (which is a customized Bitstream Vera Sans Mono).
meslo.name: Meslo LG

miracode.author: Idrees Hassan
